name: 3-Ingredient Frozen Whipped Lemonade

ingredients.name: fresh lemon juice, plus additional zest for serving

instructions.primary_message: In a medium bowl, combine lemon zest and sugar. Using fingers, rub together until sugar feels damp and mixture is fragrant, about 1 minute. Let stand for 20 minutes, rubbing sugar mixture together every few minutes until very fragrant.
In a blender, combine lemon juice, sweetened condensed milk, sugar mixture, and 1 cup ice. Blend until smooth and creamy, about 30 seconds.
Add remaining 3 cups ice and blend until thick and fluffy, about 30 seconds. Divide evenly between 2 chilled glasses. Top with additional lemon zest, if desired, and serve immediately.

schema_metadata.keywords: lemonade, frozen lemonade, whipped lemonade, iced lemonade, frozen whipped lemonade

description: This frozen whipped lemonade is bright, tart, and impossibly fluffy, with sweetened condensed milk adding creamy body and a smooth icy texture.
notes: Make-ahead and storage: This iced drink is best enjoyed immediately after blending.
author: Laila Ibrahim
